title: Initiative visibility: SLO dependency heatmap and rollup for reliability initiatives
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
We need a cross-team dashboard component (heatmap) in Console that visually maps active initiatives to the SLIs they rely on and the remaining error budget in each service. Goal: make it trivial for PMs, SREs, and engineering leads to spot initiatives at risk due to SLI burn and to prioritize rollouts/rollbacks. The heatmap should support time-windowed views (7d/30d/90d), allow filtering by initiative tag and service owner, and show suggested mitigations (e.g., canary pause, rate-limit throttle, fallback model) based on preconfigured playbooks.

Scope:
- Data model for initiative->SLI linkage and automated rollups of error budget usage per initiative
- Frontend heatmap widget in Console with drilldowns to initiative and SLO pages
- Backend aggregation pipeline to compute per-initiative SLI burn rate and risk score
- Alerts and visibility hooks: per-initiative Slack channel messages and PagerDuty annotations when risk>threshold
- Integration with rollout system to enable preflight gating based on initiative risk score
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap shows each active initiative on y-axis and its dependent SLIs on x-axis with color-coded error budget usage (green/yellow/red)
Clicking an initiative drills down to a list of services, current SLI value, error budget remaining, and recent regressions (last 7 days)
Heatmap supports 7d/30d/90d windows and filters by team, region, and priority
Automated aggregation updates every 5 minutes and matches canonical SLI values from telemetry
Risk score algorithm documented and reviewed by SREs; alerts created when risk score>0.7
Playbook suggestions are surfaced and link to runbooks; rollout system can block canary if risk>threshold
Unit/integration tests for aggregation pipeline and frontend smoke tests included in PR
notes: Design/UX: initial sketches in Figma (link below) — we prefer compact matrix with hover tooltips for quick context
Risk model draft: weighted sum of SLI burn rate, absolute SLI deviation, and recent incident recurrence
Expected data volume: ~1500 initiatives x 1200 SLIs; aggregation needs to be streaming-friendly
Privacy: ensure no PII in SLI metadata; mark customers with private deployment flag to filter if requested
